Held-out monthly water-use curves and uncertainty

Six models · 38 parcels · raw January–December 2021 water use · units: thousand gallons/month

How to read the figures. Every method has two clearly labeled figures. The first summarizes the average curve: black is mean observed, colored is mean LOPO prediction, and shading is a 95% paired parcel-bootstrap confidence interval for the average prediction. The second shows three actual held-out parcels: black is that parcel’s observed curve, colored is its genuine LOPO prediction, and shading is a 90% leave-one-out residual-calibrated predictive-error band. Neither band includes land-cover classification, meter, or causal-attribution uncertainty.

The seasonally regularized class-area model has the best point metrics, but its improvement over the original class-area model remains small and the paired difference interval reported in the refinement analysis includes zero. The figures should therefore be read as comparative uncertainty evidence, not as proof of a decisive ranking.

Training-mean curve

Method ID: mean_curve
How it works
  1. Exclude the held-out parcel.
  2. Average the other parcels’ 12 monthly values.
  3. Use that mean curve as the held-out prediction.
LOPO monthly MAE: 3.999 kgal  ·  RMSE: 7.522  ·  mean cosine: 0.919  ·  annual MAE: 38.831 kgal

Average held-out curve

The colored band is the 95% paired parcel-bootstrap interval for the method’s mean held-out monthly prediction. The bootstrap resamples the same 38 observed/predicted parcel pairs, preserving their 12-month curves. The bootstrap interval for overall monthly MAE is 3.195–4.989 kgal.

Actual held-out parcel examples

These are the same lower-, middle-, and higher-use parcels for every method. Each colored curve is the parcel’s genuine LOPO prediction. For each displayed parcel, the 90% band is calibrated month by month from absolute held-out residuals of the other 37 parcels, excluding the displayed parcel itself. It is an empirical predictive-error band, not a refitted parameter interval.

Nonnegative class-area model

Method ID: class_area_nnls
How it works
  1. Measure each land-cover class area in the parcel.
  2. Estimate a nonnegative monthly unit-area curve for each class.
  3. Multiply class rates by object areas and sum them to the parcel.
LOPO monthly MAE: 3.714 kgal  ·  RMSE: 7.370  ·  mean cosine: 0.914  ·  annual MAE: 34.953 kgal

Average held-out curve

The colored band is the 95% paired parcel-bootstrap interval for the method’s mean held-out monthly prediction. The bootstrap resamples the same 38 observed/predicted parcel pairs, preserving their 12-month curves. The bootstrap interval for overall monthly MAE is 2.859–4.779 kgal.

Proportional multi-output random forest

Method ID: proportion_multioutput_rf
How it works
  1. Calculate each parcel’s land-cover proportions.
  2. Fit one random forest to predict all 12 months together.
  3. Apply it to the held-out parcel’s proportions.
LOPO monthly MAE: 4.042 kgal  ·  RMSE: 7.432  ·  mean cosine: 0.920  ·  annual MAE: 39.319 kgal

The colored band is the 95% paired parcel-bootstrap interval for the method’s mean held-out monthly prediction. The bootstrap resamples the same 38 observed/predicted parcel pairs, preserving their 12-month curves. The bootstrap interval for overall monthly MAE is 3.268–4.991 kgal.

Continuous Landsat-conditioned class model

Method ID: landsat_class_month_nnls
How it works
  1. Attach monthly Landsat NDVI, NDMI, and EVI to each object.
  2. Estimate nonnegative class rates that vary with those values.
  3. Multiply rates by object areas and sum them to the parcel.
LOPO monthly MAE: 3.831 kgal  ·  RMSE: 7.412  ·  mean cosine: 0.922  ·  annual MAE: 36.486 kgal

The colored band is the 95% paired parcel-bootstrap interval for the method’s mean held-out monthly prediction. The bootstrap resamples the same 38 observed/predicted parcel pairs, preserving their 12-month curves. The bootstrap interval for overall monthly MAE is 2.992–4.892 kgal.

Annual class-area magnitude with common shape

Method ID: annual_class_area_common_shape
How it works
  1. Estimate annual class-area rates from the training parcels.
  2. Estimate one common monthly shape from those parcels.
  3. Distribute each object’s annual estimate across that shape and sum.
LOPO monthly MAE: 3.729 kgal  ·  RMSE: 7.360  ·  mean cosine: 0.919  ·  annual MAE: 34.792 kgal

The colored band is the 95% paired parcel-bootstrap interval for the method’s mean held-out monthly prediction. The bootstrap resamples the same 38 observed/predicted parcel pairs, preserving their 12-month curves. The bootstrap interval for overall monthly MAE is 2.864–4.846 kgal.

Seasonally regularized class-area model

Method ID: seasonally_regularized_class_area
How it works
  1. Measure each parcel’s land-cover class areas.
  2. Fit all nonnegative class-month rates jointly while smoothing adjacent months.
  3. Multiply the smoothed rates by object areas and sum them to the parcel.
LOPO monthly MAE: 3.667 kgal  ·  RMSE: 7.342  ·  mean cosine: 0.920  ·  annual MAE: 34.733 kgal
